text:
The constraints force two blocks: Ben–Cara–Dev in three consecutive slots, and Hana–Ivo in two consecutive slots, with Ivo before Cara. Finn must sit at least three slots before Hana, so the only placement that leaves room is Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–8–9 and Hana–Ivo in 5–6, with Finn in 1.

The remaining slots are 2, 3, and 4 for Ann, Elif, and Gus. Elif before Ivo, Ann before Gus, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, and Ann at least three slots from Ivo fix them as Elif, Ann, Gus.

That assignment satisfies every constraint, and every other block placement contradicts at least one of them.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Elif","3":"Ann","4":"Gus","5":"Hana","6":"Ivo","7":"Ben","8":"Cara","9":"Dev"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
